info.title: Business OS project reporting API
info.description: Read-only contract for Doppler (project_id doppler) and SMS Code (project_id smscode). Not a deployed API. Intervals are [from, to) UTC instants. Daily finance buckets use the requested IANA timezone. GSC rows stay on America/Los_Angeles dates.

businessOsHmac.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256. Also send X-BOS-Key-Id, X-BOS-Timestamp, and X-BOS-Nonce. See hmac.md.
